entries.message: When a website keeps a shortcut such as Command-S, Crest says to press it again, and the second press runs Crest's command. Choose Prefer Crest, Use Both or Prefer Website for each shortcut in Settings › Shortcuts, and switching Spaces now always reaches Crest.
Binding Command-Z or another editing shortcut to a command no longer takes Undo, Copy or Paste away from the text field you're typing in.
